author: Dana Whitfield
entry: Spot logged HRSG-2 HP drum level gauge LG-2101 at 62% on the 15:10 run. Local reading at the glass was 48%. Looking at the image, afternoon sun through the west louvers is putting a big white glare patch right over the gauge face. Third time this week the afternoon run has been wrong on this one.

author: Ravi Shah
entry: Mission 'HRSG Upper Decks' aborted at stairwell S-3 because two contractors were coming down the stairs. Spot stopped, waited a few seconds, and went back to the dock. Drum level, safety valve and blowdown checks on decks 4-6 never happened that run, and nobody told us it had aborted until we noticed the gap in the report.

author: Luis Ortega
entry: Spot raised an elevated hydrogen alert near the generator seal oil unit at 03:12. It sat unacknowledged in the web dashboard until day shift opened it at 07:05. Nobody on nights has the dashboard open, they're watching the DCS. Turned out to be a minor fitting leak, but four hours on an H2 alert is not acceptable. Notified Luis Ortega's on-call cover; walkdown logged under badge E40213.
